notes.title: New Event Story "Highlander Railroad Runaway Incident" Update
notes.notes:
[p align="justify"]Event Story - Highlander Railroad Runaway Incident: And the Train Disappeared
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/443c27b9-10a1-4e4c-9171-98e4e851f0da/BA%ED%95%98%EC%9D%B4%EB%9E%9C%EB%93%9C%EC%B2%A0%EB%8F%84%ED%8F%AD%EC%A3%BC%EC%82%AC%EA%B1%B4%EC%BB%A4%EB%AE%A4%EB%8B%88%ED%8B%B0780x440EN.png"]
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]🔹 Event Schedule
[p align="justify"]- Event Schedule: 9/23 (Tue) After Maintenance – 10/7 (Tue) 1:59 AM (UTC)
[p align="justify"]- Shop, Task, Mini Game, and Event Reward Claim and Exchange Schedule: 9/23 (Tue) After Maintenance – 10/14 (Tue) 1:59 AM (UTC)
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]🔹 Event Details
[p align="justify"]- Clear Mission 2-3 (Normal) to participate in the "Highlander Railroad Runaway Incident: And the Train Disappeared" event.
[p align="justify"]- The Event Story includes content such as battles, episodes, Quests, and Challenges, as well as reward-related menus like the Prize Exchange, Shop, and Tasks.
[p align="justify"]- Sweeps can only be used in Quests.
[p align="justify"]- You can get additional repeat rewards by clearing with Specialized Effect Students.
[p align="justify"]* After the event period, unused event currencies will be converted to Credit Points, at a 1:1 ratio, and sent to your mailbox.
[p align="justify"]* Please check in-game for further details.
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Story
[p align="justify"]- Clear Story episodes to earn various rewards, like Pyroxenes and event currency.
[p align="justify"]   ㄴ Clear Story – 01 Central Control Center Planning Office, to get Aoba (1★).
[p align="justify"]- Once you clear the event story, you can re-watch unlocked episodes in the Story menu.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/46d17aef-59fd-4fd7-866f-fac184d6f7d2/image.png"]
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Quests
[p align="justify"]- Clear Quests to earn various rewards like Credit Points and Artifacts.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/4ab1862d-6ecb-4afe-9061-237194fad598/image.png"]
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Challenges
[p align="justify"]- Challenges open 9/23 (Tue) 7:00 PM (UTC).
[p align="justify"]- Event Challenges only have 3★ and First Clear Rewards. Clearing Challenges more than once will not grant additional rewards.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/267efbe5-dd71-4b93-93f2-4a6bfb52411d/image.png"]
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Tasks
[p align="justify"]- Clear Event Tasks to earn rewards like Titles, Credit Points, Pyroxene, and Secret Tech Notes.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/71b411b5-1860-496f-911f-0dadfe831b57/image.png"]
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Specialized Student Effects
[p align="justify"]- Specialized Students grant bonuses for each event currency.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ In the event screen, go to Specialized Students → Event Currency to view the details.
[p align="justify"]- The Specialized Effect applies to stages in both Story and Quests.
[p align="justify"]- Specialized Effects only apply to repeat rewards.
[p align="justify"]- Once a Specialized Effect is applied, it remains permanently applied to that stage. The effect also applies to Sweeps.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/6d3120f7-60ed-432b-8ed0-1220fccb4ab7/EventPlayGuide8461En.png"]
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/f2b88bf8-7990-4c30-a0bb-06a17b47e0bb/EventPlayGuide8462En.png"]
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/eee3ffbf-93ef-4182-ada5-4c757a4eaff9/EventPlayGuide8463En.png"]
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Shop
[p align="justify"]- Currencies you earn from Story and Quest stages can be traded for items in the event shop.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/d9d8be37-0f53-4161-ae61-5ada45902471/EventPlayGuide8464En.png"]
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Mini Game
[p align="justify"]- Use Highlander Stickers to play the puzzle-based railroad construction mini game.
[p align="justify"]- Trains run once a single track connects the departure, layover, and arrival stations.
[p align="justify"]- Earn rewards by placing tracks on their optimal routes and running the train.
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]1) How to Place Tracks
[p align="justify"]- Place your "Current Track" on an empty tile.
[p align="justify"]  * The set number of "Current Tracks" will be randomly designated. This cannot be changed.
[p align="justify"]- Use the Rotate button to change the direction of the "Current Track."
[p align="justify"]- Use the Check button to place "Highlander Stickers" and position the "Current Track" in a certain direction.
[p align="justify"]- Starting from round 7, you can press the Skip button to skip track placements.
[p align="justify"]* Skipping will obtain all available round rewards.
[p align="justify"]* Skipping will consume the number of Highlander Stickers otherwise needed to place tracks on the remaining empty tiles.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/b6341739-b677-46d5-82b9-25716a047381/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8462En.png"]
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/09d2087e-72bd-4830-ae85-0d3e741695cf/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8463En.png"]
[p align="justify"]2) How to Change Tracks
[p align="justify"]- Once placed, tracks can be moved or rotated without consuming additional currency.
[p align="justify"]* Select a placed track to swap it to an empty or placed track space. You can also rotate it.
[p align="justify"]* Departure, Layover, and Arrival stations cannot be moved or rotated.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/3848ad4e-cfa3-425e-a538-4ca5c16f2050/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8464En.png"]
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]3) How to Run the Train
[p align="justify"]- After placing tracks and connecting Departure, Layover, and Arrival stations, the "Start Train" button will become available.
[p align="justify"]  * On certain maps you can activate the "Start Train" button without placing tracks on all available tiles.
[p align="justify"]- Press the "Start Train" button to run the train. A speed control lever will appear at bottom right of the screen.
[p align="justify"]- Use the speed control lever to change the speed of the train.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/ec528363-b45f-4e2f-8d1d-7e3ce55e583b/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8461En.png"]
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]4) Train Rewards
[p align="justify"]- The round ends once the train reaches the Arrival station. Round rewards and bonus rewards will then be available.
[p align="justify"]* You can only obtain bonus rewards that are on the train's route.
[p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/adf085ad-ae90-409e-9c38-395764fdf858/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8465En.png"]

notes.title: New “Archive Recruitment” Starts on 9/23(Tue) & Recruitment Changes Notice
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643295/e300c53b1b3f6e84c4d2b75b67359eb8f8e7ae0b.png"]

We would like to provide a prior notice regarding the upcoming changes to the “Available Student List” for certain Recruitments, as well as the addition of a new Recruitment type, “Archive Recruitment,” which will be applied starting from the maintenance on 9/23(Tue).
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]\[Details on the Recruitment System Changes (9/23(Tue))]
[p align="justify"]1. Addition of the New Recruitment: “Archive Recruitment”
[p align="justify"]- Starting from the maintenance on 9/23(Tue), you will be able to conduct an Archive Recruitment, where you can select one 3★ Student from the Archive Recruitment pool as the Pickup target (Pickup Rate: 0.700000%).
[p align="justify"]* The list of 3★ Students available in Archive Recruitment can be found in the \[Archive Recruitment 3★ Student List].
[p align="justify"]* Further details regarding Archive Recruitment will be provided in the upcoming \[Archive Recruitment Notice].
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]2. Changes to the Available Student List in Regular Recruitment / Pick-Up Recruitment / Unique Pick-Up Recruitment / Guaranteed 3★ Recruitment / Fest Recruitment
[p align="justify"]- Starting from the maintenance on 9/23(Tue), the 38 Students included in the \[Archive Recruitment 3★ Student List] will only be obtainable through Archive Recruitment.
[p align="justify"]* These Students will no longer appear in Regular Recruitment, Pick-Up Recruitment, Unique Pick-Up Recruitment, Guaranteed 3★ Recruitment, or Fest Recruitment.
